correctness.rationale: Exact N/2 orthogonal two-mode Fourier alias decomposition with Q_delta=2^-1/2[[1,1],[exp(-(2-delta)t),exp(-(2+delta)t)]]. Gram trace and determinant yield closed-form endpoints. Differentiation shows both eigenvalues strictly increasing with delta>0 and extreme aliases give parity and sharp bounds. Uniform Rayleigh envelope t² exp(-2t) for normalized worst bound, compact convergence to t²/(1+exp(4t)), unique maximizing root 2t=1+exp(-4t), and Nd_N→2pi prove the N^-2 law and maximizing-delay convergence. The included checker directly verifies 105 finite matrices and 6 asymptotic scales. All operators, norms, and t>0 quantifiers specified.

value.rationale: Sharp, mathematically motivated full-signal dynamical observability on finite cycle graphs. The exactly characterized parity-dependent blind mode is structurally important, and optimizing the worst singular-energy bound gives the universal physical delay tau and the optimal N^-2 stability rate with exact coefficient. This answers an experimentally meaningful temporal-design question; it is not a finite enumeration, a merely negative result, or a corollary of an existence-only frame criterion.
